title: Review of your draft with ranked fixes
summary: An expert read of your deck, plan, proposal, copy, survey, lesson, paper or help docs. You get ranked fixes based on what your reader needs.
deliverable: A review tied to your text: a verdict on each slide, section, goal or question; gaps, weak claims, risky promises and numbers that do not match, each quoted with its fix and ranked by impact; a check against any rules you paste; rewrites of the weakest parts (the whole text if under 500 words); and the questions your reader will ask.

Rewrite the three weakest parts in full (or the whole text if it is under 500 words) and list the questions the reader will ask. Point out what works too. Do not add facts, numbers or sources that are not in the draft or brief, and do not say any claim is legal or compliant.
not_for: Legal or regulatory sign-off on claims, labels or contracts

Coursework, theses or exams to be graded as your own work
